scope: Read-only independent review of frozen BLE typed frame/protected slot integration, stream epoch cancellation, local completion accounting and snapshot getter. Scheduler already independently passed review02. Upstream transport deadline repair and root-owned query formatter/collector review are separate gates. No hardware, build or production edits.
verifiedOwnership: Two independent protected payload slots each hold the full2304 bytes; existing four DATA/two LOG/two CTRL capacities remain independent. Protected DATA does not set ctrlSlot and therefore does not inherit512-byte storage or500ms-per-fragment CTRL retry behavior.

Protected allocation sets WRITING while holding s_bleMux, then CRC/copy occur outside the lock. Producer replacement only considers PENDING. Commit rechecks slot generation, connection, stream and effective active state before changing WRITING toPENDING.
ReceiveProtected selects and changes PENDING toOWNED under the same s_bleMux. There is no queue-pop/late-mark-owned window available to a competing producer.

Disconnect drain only claims PENDING via ReceiveProtected and queue-owned ordinary descriptors. It cannot free WRITING or the SDK/confirmation owner. A writer racing reconnect releases its own generation after failed commit.
The sole TX owner releases after SendDescriptor actually returns. The independent guard latches quarantine and admission refusal without cancelling or freeing the owned SDK buffer.

Each descriptor carries immutable copied frame identity and a policy ticket. Caller full/preview pointers do not escape the synchronous admission. Real encoder bytes are preserved exactly, including X invalid points.
verifiedEpochAndCompletion: Effective DATA active transitions advance streamGeneration, including same-connection unsubscribe/resubscribe and FAST/SAFE changes that change effective sendability. Connection generation remains separate.

Each fragment/context and the atomic SDK admission predicate check current connection, stream, CCCD, mode and confirmation selection. SAFE completion checks the DATA stream again after confirmation wait.

A complete local success from an older configuration cannot clear firstPending for a newer current revision. Periodic completion additionally requires matching periodicGeneration to retire the current obligation.

A failed or partial message leaves the protection obligation; subsequent real frames can offer a replacement. FULL/protected path always uses fullData while ordinary CAP SHORT may use the legacy B20 preview.

Protected completion advances a BLE-only original identity/sequence floor. Older/equal ordinary records are dropped with counters; all original scientific identities remain unchanged and no USB/Wi-Fi label or loss is inferred.
Sequence ordering is limited to matching boot/session and a strict half-range relation. Cross-boot sequence reset is not treated as old.
verifiedObservation: Flow getter acquires s_bleMux before sampling nowUs and copying last-completion state; completion timestamp updates also occur under that mux. It additionally emits ageKnown only when now>=lastCompleteUs, avoiding unsigned underflow.
gapKnown is reset for a new config/stream and becomes true only with two successful protected full completions in the same configuration.
Policy observation timestamps are obtained after serializing state, preventing a preempted earlier timestamp from resetting the pure scheduler.

Intentional ordinary skips returnNOT_ALLOWED and increment policy skip, not DATA drop/slot allocation failure. Capacity rejection, other failure, full local completion and protected bookkeeping remain distinct.
No new RSSI or other potentially blocking SDK query is introduced by this policy.
residualSemantics: The1s BLE cadence is a due/obligation target observed when a real eligible frame is offered, not a hard deadline for local completion or PC delivery. Sustained CTRL/lifecycle priority can keep a same-config FIRST_CONFIG slot PENDING indefinitely; the other bounded slot can refresh periodic pending data and missed-period counters are explicit. No new finite pending-age promise is made.

Once a message is selected, its fragments retain ownership and are not preempted by a later control reply. An indefinitely blocked SDK call quarantines later sends but may prevent BLE TX control responses; USB/control recovery remains a separate path.

protectedFailed is not a total for every protected record discarded. Disconnect drains and early stale-descriptor returns also use generic dropD/stale counters; queued-complete-failed must not be interpreted as queue depth or end-to-end loss.

The helper passes the immutable owner ticket as its pending completion candidate; OWNED slots cannot be superseded, and current config/periodic-generation gates remain necessary when clearing external obligations.
No host receipt, weak-RF performance or final transport throughput is inferred from SDK acceptance/CONF or host-only tests.
